about: Hand labels for 19 filings, drawn at random (seed 7) from filings filed 28 Sep to 27 Oct 2026, with a quota per category so rare kinds are included. Labels follow FINN's own definitions in the triage prompt. Where two labels are both defensible, both are accepted; the note says why. Labelled by reading the full filing, including annexures.

filings.what: Quarterly business update: advances up about 15% year on year
filings.note: Not the results. The prompt puts monthly and quarterly business updates at glance.
A document that accompanies results, which the prompt puts at glance.
